triggeredBy.choiceText: Launch the invasion. Annex their resources.
Reject it. The West's sanctions would cripple us.
Negotiate. Blame the generals. Seek face-saving exit.
Launch the invasion. Annex their resources.
Fine. Limited 'peacekeeping operation.' Just the border region.
Launch the invasion. Annex their resources.
Escalate. Full invasion. Mobilize reserves. Flatten cities.

Brutal pacification. Collective punishment. Mass arrests.
Level it. Artillery, airstrikes, total war. Grozny doctrine.
Maintain the siege. Starvation is a weapon. They'll surrender.
Collective punishment. Villages that harbor rebels get razed.
Continue the campaign. More missiles. Break them completely.
Full mobilization. Every man 18-60. Close the borders.
Pay mercenaries. Private military companies. No conscription.
Dig in. Limited objectives. Hold what we have, claim victory.
Negotiate. Blame the generals. Seek face-saving exit.
Wait. Use as negotiating leverage for peace talks.
Offer to restore power in exchange for territorial concessions.
Walk away from talks. We fight until total victory.
Dig in. Limited objectives. Hold what we have, claim victory.
Withdraw to defensible lines. Cut losses. Fortress strategy.
Ceasefire. Freeze current lines. Korea-style armistice.
Walk away from talks. We fight until total victory.
One more push. Break the stalemate. Mobilize again.
Full mobilization. Every man 18-60. Close the borders.
Renege on the deal. Slowly strip their autonomy away.
Full military assault. No negotiations with traitors.
Declare the vote illegal. Double military pressure. No surrender.
Massive retaliation. Bomb their 'capital.' Kill their leadership.
Walk away. These demands are insulting. Resume military operations.
Full military assault. No negotiations with traitors.
Blockade the province. Cut power, water, food. Strangle them.
Level it. Artillery, airstrikes, total war. Grozny doctrine.
Slow advance. Minimize civilian casualties. Months of grinding war.
Covert campaign. Assassinate their leaders. Destabilize their 'state.'
Negotiate. Offer expanded autonomy. Keep them in the federation.
Withdraw. This is unwinnable. Cut a deal now.
Lift the blockade. The optics are destroying us internationally.
Unilateral ceasefire. Someone has to stop first. (Seen as weakness)
Recognize reality. Negotiate terms of separation. Salvage what we can.
Controlled withdrawal. Defend key infrastructure only. Admit partial defeat.
Escalate to overwhelming force. Break them completely. End it.
Accept their demands. Autonomy is better than independence.
Massive retaliation. Bomb their 'capital.' Kill their leadership.
Route it through the nephew. He 'earned' this.
Take 10%, fill the treasury with the rest.
Cut the gas. Winter is coming. Let them beg.
Triple the price. $2,000 per cubic meter. Take it or freeze.
Enforce it strictly. No rubles, no gas. Total currency warfare.
Route it through the nephew. He 'earned' this.
Take 10%, fill the treasury with the rest.
Honor contracts. Maintain reliable supply. Long game.
Cut the gas. Winter is coming. Let them beg.
Triple the price. $2,000 per cubic meter. Take it or freeze.
Accept reduced market share. Focus on Asia. Europe's lost anyway.
Take 10%, fill the treasury with the rest.
Triple the price. $2,000 per cubic meter. Take it or freeze.
Honor contracts. Maintain reliable supply. Long game.
Route it through the nephew. He 'earned' this.
Offer to rebuild—for triple the original cost.
Sanction evasion. Shell companies. Front businesses. Criminal networks.
Promote him. Defense Minister. Keep him close. Control him from within.
Strike first. Arrest him and 40 officers. Decapitate his network.
Presidential coup. Arrest him. Declare emergency. Winner takes all.
Arrest him tonight. Treason charges. Fake coup plot evidence.
Power-sharing. Make him Prime Minister. Co-rule. (Temporary truce)
Strengthen presidency. Transfer powers from PM. Constitutional changes.
Slow coup. Remove his allies one by one. Year-long campaign to weaken him.
Fight. Rally loyalists. Promise them everything. This is my country.
Go silent. Disappear for months. Rule from an undisclosed bunker.
Send riot police. Beat them. Arrest the leaders. End this now.
Midnight raid. SWAT teams. Clear it violently. National TV blackout.
Ignore them. Students always protest. They'll get bored and graduate.
Siege tactics. Cut power, water, food. Wait them out. Slow pressure.
Meet with them. Listen. Promise vague reforms. Co-opt the moderates.
Negotiate. End the occupation peacefully. Grant minor concessions.
Make real concessions. Anti-corruption reforms. Release political prisoners.
Deny. Cover up. Threaten the family. Arrest anyone who investigates.
Declare them a terrorist organization. Mass arrests. Label it a foreign coup.
State of emergency. Military in the streets. Shoot strikers. Total war.
Reject. These demands are unacceptable. No negotiations with traitors.
Full internet crackdown. Block social media. VPN ban. Information war.
Approve the hit. Send the special team to London.
Freeze his assets. Arrest his brother. His kids can't leave.
Disinformation campaign. He's mentally unstable. A thief.
